name: A designated payment can settle a newer liability ahead of FIFO
title: SC-13-09-01 A designated payment can settle a newer liability ahead of FIFO
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F5
When the manager records a payment of 1522.50 for "A-5" designating "Kasım 2026"
Then the payment settles November principal and late fee
And September 1675.00 and October 1600.00 remain open
And the ledger invariants hold
